svg.title: Figure 1 · Standards applicability
svg.desc: Every standard the framework names with its status
svg.text: The 17 standards the framework names and how each is used. Status is a project choice, not a contractual applicability or a certification
claim; only MIL-STD-882E is encoded as data and checked.
Integrated walker/UAV/GSE safety program; modeled as data in standards/mil-std-882e/model.yaml, tailored in
Walker mechanical hazards and risk reduction
Functional safety lifecycle and E/E/PE control methods
SUS-A1 FHA, PSSA, SSA, FMEA, FTA and CCA
Airborne software and electronic hardware assurance
Tool qualification or applicable software supplements
Military airworthiness criteria if required by authority
Techniques only if a suitable vehicle/autonomy use case is defined
Generated by tools/figures/framework_readme.py from the framework pages, the MIL-STD-882E tailoring and task records. Project-defined framework; no gate has passed and no compliance is claimed.

g.text: Terms: ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · AS9100 = aerospace quality
management standard · CCA = common cause analysis · DO-178C = RTCA software considerations in airborne systems · DO-254 = RTCA design assurance for airborne electronic hardware · DO-330 =
RTCA software tool qualification considerations · DoD = US Department of Defense · EIA = Electronic Industries Alliance · EIA-649 = SAE / EIA configuration management standard · EMI =
electromagnetic interference · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · FMEA = failure modes and effects analysis · FTA = fault tree analysis ·
IEC = International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC 61508 functional safety) · ISO = International Organization for Standardization (ISO 12100 machinery risk, ISO 13849 control safety, ISO
26262 road vehicles) · MIL-HDBK-516 = US DoD airworthiness certification criteria handbook · MIL-STD-1472 = US DoD design criteria for human engineering · MIL-STD-461 = US DoD
electromagnetic interference requirements · MIL-STD-810H = US DoD environmental engineering test methods · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base
edition) · NIST = US National Institute of Standards and Technology · PSSA = preliminary system safety assessment (ARP4761A) · RTCA = RTCA, Inc., publisher of DO-178C and DO-254 · SAE = SAE
International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SP = Special Publication (NIST) · SSA = system safety assessment (ARP4761A) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial
